wire.encoding: Each marker is followed by exactly one ASCII space, UTF8(JSON.stringify(parsed body)) in normative order, then a single LF. Caps exclude marker, that space and LF. Artifact payload is the exact outcome body followed by ONE byte 0x0a, thus at most 24577 bytes total. No BOM/extra LF/duplicate keys/extra fields/whitespace/CR/smuggled second marker. ZIP size limit 1048576 bytes; specified sole exact filename, listing count1/7d/private, measured archive digest and inflated bytes agree with API/log. Overall transport log max4194304. A body of 24576 is legal only if all semantic/shape rules also hold; never enlarge the body cap to fit LF.

journal.unknown: If recorderFaultObserved=true, witness.integrity='ambiguous' and unknownReason='RECORDER_FAULT' (also if an invalid/torn record is present). Else if the first unaccepted complete record is invalid (including invalid alias), integrity='ambiguous', reason='JOURNAL_INVALID_RECORD'. Else if any incomplete final line follows valid complete rows, integrity='torn', reason='JOURNAL_TORN'. Else if no data, integrity='empty', reason='JOURNAL_EMPTY'. All four set frontier='unknown',openCase=null,afterOpen=false, where null/false are protocol sentinels and cannot establish absence. Preserve valid preceding rows and native evidence independently. For prefix or complete require unknownReason=null, stable true and no recorder fault.
